verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships as a single binary and a Docker image that serves an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API, and it can be launched and configured entirely from the CLI or environment (for example, preloading models with --preload-models). That points to server-side, non-interactive deployment. However, no doc explicitly states that it runs headless or that the built-in web UI can be turned off, and nothing shows use inside a CI pipeline. missing for 10: explicit headless/no-UI mode documentation, option to disable the built-in web interface, documented CI pipeline usage, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it.
PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
